title: GraphEvent
description: The payload of every artifact-graph event (docs/design/m0/13), discriminated by type: node.recorded/v1, node.claimed/v1, node.reused/v1, node.reuse_released/v1, node.renewed/v1, node.invalidated/v1, node.hold_raised/v1, node.hold_paged/v1, node.hold_cleared/v1 and node.operated/v1 under the node's id, review.superseded/v1 under the predecessor's id, queue.observed/v1 under its task, result.recorded/v1 and result.selected/v1 under the result's id; each in the node's project. internal/graph folds them into the graph projections in the writer transaction and refuses one its state does not derive.

NodeRecorded.description: A node joins its task's graph, append-only: its task, its project and the node it succeeds (null for a first round).

NodeClaimed.description: A node's claim on its computation key (13 [G10]): its inputs as they resolved, fixed from here on, and the key they give. A claim is a node instance's: a repeat demand of the node joins it and records nothing; a memoizable kind's key is claimed once per task.

inputs.description: Each declared input and what it resolved to, in declared order: a result, or an approval with its revision. A new kind of resolution is a new event version (node.claimed/v2), since every field is required.

NodeInvalidated.description: An explicit, recorded invalidation (13 [G1]): the node's claim moves to the next generation, with the same inputs, so its key changes and its selected result, if any, no longer answers it.

NodeReused.description: A memoizable instance refused a claim because another node of its task holds its key completes by reuse (13 [G10]): the holder's selected result at the current generation, same task, kind and key. inputs are the instance's own resolved inputs. It never claims and never runs, and is never invalidated on its own: the holder's invalidation releases it (node.reuse_released).

NodeReuseReleased.description: The holder of key was invalidated or renewed, and the node bound to key by reuse is released in the same command (13 [G1]): its reuse and its result are dropped, and it waits for its inputs again, to reuse or claim at the new generation.

NodeRenewed.description: Renewal, the one exception to a key selecting once (13 [G1]): the receipt of the node's selected result expired at valid_until, by the event's time, so the same key reopens, claimed with no selected result, for a result recorded after this event. The generation and the claim stay. receipt is the content digest of the result's one receipt Ref, and valid_until the validity the result bound when recorded.

NodeOperated.description: An effect node's operation was intended (13 [G4], G7a): effect is the durable effect (03) of the node's request at key, its claim's key, intended in the same command. One per node and key: a resume finds it, and the node's next generation is a new operation. It is the graph's link from the node to its effect.

QueueObserved.description: A merge queue's observation of its branch's base head (13 "Merge-queue generations", G7b-1b): the head with the forge's version of the branch, which rises with every move of the head. The latest observation of each task and branch is kept: an older version, or another head at the same version, is refused, so a delayed observation never moves the queue back.

ReviewSuperseded.description: A roster change replaces a review (13 "Replacement is a recorded supersession"), in one writer transaction with the attempt stops it needs. The predecessor is superseded. The replacement keeps its round, inputs, requirements and effect, with the roster of its subject's next requirement revision, to which its review_requirement input moves; it takes the predecessor's successor slot, and its lineage includes what the predecessor asked. stopped_attempts are the attempts its caller named for the predecessor that this command stopped (attempt.stop_requested{preempt}, before this event), each listed once across supersessions; until M1 binds attempts to nodes, the list is not proven complete. Each of the predecessor's holds is in exactly one of transferred_holds and retired_holds, in the predecessor's order: a wait the replacement still has transfers to it with its id, since and pages; one it no longer has is retired with its reason.

transferred_holds.description: The holds the replacement now holds, unchanged.

retired_holds.description: The holds that leave with the predecessor, each with its reason.

RetiredHold.description: A hold a supersession retires: invalidated, a retry wait of the predecessor's key, which the replacement does not hold; member_removed, a reviewer_unavailable wait on an executor the replacement's roster drops; question_moved, an awaiting_input wait on an answer the predecessor declares and the replacement replaces because its question moved to another owed input.

HoldRaised.description: An external wait on the node (02 "Hold reasons and resume signals"): raised at the event's time with no page yet. result is set exactly when the hold has a reason: it is the retry wait of the node's could_not_run result of its current key (13 [G2]), one hold per result.

HoldPaged.description: A page of the hold at the event's time, for its signal instance, once per owner and owner_ref: the fold refuses a repeated (owner, owner_ref), and the pager must not retry it (02: by hold id and signal instance). The owner's first page may come at once; page_after times only the escalation, from which on a page may go to the recorded escalate_to, which then owns the hold.

HoldCleared.description: The hold leaves the node, with its cause: its signal arrived (the hold's signal instance), or it was retired with a reason (invalidated: a retry wait of an old key; revised: an awaiting_input wait on a revision of its owed input that the successor recorded in the same command answers at a newer one). A supersession transfers or retires holds in its own event (review.superseded).

ResultRecorded.description: An immutable result of a claimed node, with the attempt that produced it (null for a controller node).

receipt_valid_until.description: The valid_until of the receipt the result's one receipt Ref names, bound once when the result is recorded (null: no such receipt, or no limit). Renewal checks expiry against it; the resolver refuses a receipt that differs.

attempt.description: Checked by this schema only until M1 binds attempts to nodes.

isolation.description: The isolation proof of the evidence run that produced the result (12 "Content"); null for every other kind. An evidence result that is not could_not_run needs its attempt and a proof from that attempt's run that proves its isolation (internal/evidence CheckIsolation).

ResultSelected.description: The node selects its result: a completed result that is not could_not_run (13 [G2]), answering the node's current key, once per claim.
